scope: Initial draft findings, resolved by inspected final source and focused production consumers; see live-integration.json for actual scope and records

findings.trigger: Canonical fragment appears after the raw transfer returns, while raw version or raw fence stays unchanged.
findings.amplification: Early return can leave canonical committed pictures at zero; finish then decodes the complete canonical stream instead of only its tail.
findings.acceptance: Actual raw and canonical reader work before stop, with continuing canonical progress despite unchanged raw fence.
findings.disposition: Resolved: canonical file notifications advance independently of raw-fence changes; final live consumers perform both reads before same-candidate publication.

findings.trigger: Later append or closure changes an already-scanned canonical prefix.
findings.impact: Cached pixel hash could certify changed closed media if only the new tail is decoded.
findings.acceptance: Rebind canonical encoded prefix, clocks, mapping and format before reuse; preserve failed operands.
findings.disposition: Resolved: canonical encoded prefix, origin, mapping and format are checked before later and closed reuse.

findings.trigger: Speculative private writer or candidate verification fails during finish.
findings.impact: Draft throwing finish bypasses raw-first validation and the generic publication route.
findings.acceptance: Cancellation propagates; other speculative unavailability retains original raw-first publication outcomes.
findings.disposition: Resolved: cancellation propagates; other private finish failures discard optional work and enter existing raw-first publication.

findings.trigger: Conservative SDK self-boundary may-order queries return true.
findings.impact: Requiring false rejects every full-sync point in the saved retained fixture, so no capture-era work can start.
findings.acceptance: Actual complete DTS/PTS separation and physical closing-IDR/mapping evidence; preserve unknown SDK answers as diagnostics.
findings.disposition: Resolved: actual DTS/PTS partition and physical closing-picture proof qualify the prefix without assuming negative SDK may-order answers.

dismissals.bound: One active task and one replaceable latest request under the existing mutex.
dismissals.disposition: No new queue/actor framework justified by the inspected draft.

dismissals.bound: Ingress writes complete row bytes; the existing close boundary synchronizes once.
dismissals.disposition: Preserve existing policy; no new per-frame synchronization.

remaining: Sustained advancement/backlog/resource and original completed-stop measurement
General release/physical acceptance is outside the focused fixture proof

laterReview.finding: Pre-receipt retry reused completed pixel proof without binding private candidate bytes
laterReview.disposition: Resolved: completed state pins candidate identity; actual filesystem receipt fault and mutated-candidate red/green are retained.

laterReview.finding: Unused live private stages survived permanent failure before inner publication
laterReview.disposition: Resolved: terminal settlement discards unfinished verification; complete receipt-bound candidates remain retained. Actual malformed-marker and explicit discard cases pass.
